create_ListDataset: create a ListDataset wrapping an existing dataset with optional sizes for batching
iterate_ListDataset: iterate over all samples in a ListDataset using its iterator protocol
collate_ListDataset_samples: collate a batch of samples from a ListDataset returning them unchanged
query_ListDataset_sizes: query the sizes property of a ListDataset to get per-sample size information
get_ListDataset_num_tokens: get the number of tokens at a given index using num_tokens on a ListDataset
